items.title: Lazada — print label (PDF)
items.note: Unmask approved; switched to the AWB PDF endpoint (/order/document/awb/pdf/get) and unwrap its iframe to fetch the real PDF. Works in the UI viewer and the WMS label API.

items.title: Batch label print (combined PDF)
items.note: Backend endpoint ready; UI multi-select pending.

items.title: Auto-dispatch to network printer
items.note: Phase 2 — adapter API ready, dispatcher layer pending.

items.title: Shopee — Pickup & Drop-off (ship_order)
items.note: 'จัดส่งสินค้า' action in the Order detail + Orders table — Drop-off or Pickup via Shopee ship_order. Tracking number returns immediately and the order flips to PROCESSED.

items.title: Shopee — Auto-pickup background service
items.note: Auto-arranges Pickup for READY_TO_SHIP orders once a WMS Shipped-Completed (status 95) event lands, then flips them to PROCESSED. Opt-in via Shopee:AutoPickup:Enabled.

items.title: External Pickup API — POST /api/orders/{id}/pickup
items.note: Lets an external system (WMS / ERP) trigger Pickup by internal order id. Marketplace-agnostic — dispatches to the order's own adapter; idempotent on retry.

items.title: TikTok — Pickup (ship_package, Pickup only)
items.note: ShipOrderAsync implemented via packages/{id}/ship (Pickup only; TikTok manages the SEA handover) + จัดส่งสินค้า button for AWAITING_SHIPMENT orders. Pending verification on a live order.

items.title: Lazada — Pickup / arrange shipment
items.note: Lazada fulfilment runs in its own flow; the ship_order adapter is not yet implemented.
